description: Defines Vulkan API pipeline-related classes, structures, and functions for managing Vulkan pipelines, layouts, and caches within the ATen native Vulkan backend.

classes.name: PipelineBarrier
classes.description: Represents a Vulkan pipeline barrier with source and destination stages, buffers, and images.

classes.name: PipelineLayout
classes.description: Encapsulates a Vulkan pipeline layout, managing its creation, destruction, and swap operations.

classes.name: ComputePipeline
classes.description: Represents a Vulkan compute pipeline, including its descriptor, handle, and associated resources.

classes.name: PipelineLayoutCache
classes.description: Caches pipeline layouts to optimize Vulkan pipeline creation, thread-safe with mutex management.

classes.name: ComputePipelineCache
classes.description: Caches compute pipelines for efficient reuse, thread-safe with mutex management.

methods.name: vk_access
methods.description: Returns Vulkan access flags based on pipeline stage and memory access flags.

methods.name: vk_stage
methods.description: Returns Vulkan pipeline stage flags based on custom pipeline stage flags.

methods.name: vk_layout
methods.description: Returns Vulkan image layout based on pipeline stage and memory access flags.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves a pipeline layout or compute pipeline from cache based on key.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Clears the cache of pipeline layouts or compute pipelines.
